_source: InventoryParser scout output, session 2026-08-24. Anchors verified against working tree at read time; implementer MUST re-grep line ranges before editing.
architecture: renderSectionContent (SettingsPage.tsx L1832–3324) switch on `activeSection` has 5 arms over 7 legacy ids: general→input, hotkeys→input, {speechToText,llms,localModel}→null (real content lives in always-mounted-after-first-visit TabPanels after the return JSX, keyed by mountedSections lazy-keep-alive state), privacyData→storage, system→system. All state comes from one giant useSettings() destructure (~150 fields), plus direct useSettingsStore selectors (voiceAgentKey/setVoiceAgentKey/resetWhisperVad/resetPreviewVadDefaults), and local useState/useEffect blocks for storage usage polling, ydotool diagnostics, autostart, note-files, backup/restore, model removal.

switch_cases.note: return null — conteúdo real vive nos TabPanels keep-alive fora do switch (L3325–3475), montados após primeira visita: SpeechToTextTabs (transcription), LocalModelSection+GpuDeviceSelector (models), LlmsTabs/AiModelsSection/PromptStudio/ChatAgentSettings/DictationAgentSettings/NoteFormattingSettings (aiProcessing). Props deles: cloudTranscriptionMode/setCloudTranscriptionMode, useLocalWhisper/setUseLocalWhisper, updateTranscriptionSettings, cloudTranscriptionProvider/Model/BaseUrl + setters, localTranscriptionProvider, whisperModel, parakeetModel, transcriptionMode, remoteTranscriptionUrl/Model, showTranscriptionPreview, toast, includeActiveWindowContext, screenContextOcrEngine, persistActiveWindowScreenshots, dynamicPromptVocabulary*, renderPreviewVadSettings, renderWhisperVadSettings, useCleanupModel, updateCleanupSettings.

shared_hooks.useSettings(): ~L848, alimenta TODAS as seções; nenhuma outra fonte exceto 4 seletores diretos de useSettingsStore (voiceAgentKey, setVoiceAgentKey, resetWhisperVad, resetPreviewVadDefaults) usados por hotkeys + renderers VAD
shared_hooks.useDialogs(): privacyData (resetAccessibilityPermissions) e system (removeModels, fullBackup/Restore, resetAppData); dialogs montados no return raiz
shared_hooks.useHotkeyModeInfo('settings'): hotkeys + efeito global activationMode (fora do switch)
shared_hooks.usePermissions/useSystemAudioPermission/: apenas privacyData/storage; useClipboard sem binding (efeito colateral global)
shared_hooks.useState locais: audioStorageUsage/meetingAudioStorageUsage/screenContextStorageUsage (storage, effects JÁ gated em activeSection !== 'storage' — id NOVO, inconsistente com switch antigo); ydotoolStatus/ydotoolGuideKey (input); autoStart (input); noteFiles (input); isRemovingModels/isBackingUp/isRestoringBackup (system); effectiveDefaultHotkey/linuxPttAvailable/isAgentHotkeyCommitting/mountedSections (keepalive)
shared_hooks.callbacks entre seções novas: updateTranscriptionSettings (input language + transcription panel); formatBytes/formatHotkeyLabel/getCachedPlatform helpers de módulo; renderWhisperVadSettings/renderPreviewVadSettings closures usadas APENAS pelos TabPanels (transcription)
